# 1.2.86 - the actions' numbers and cards, one Class Trial filter for Analyze, and pictures that lean with their pane

Stage E16 ships whole with this version. Its part 1 - Daggerheart's roll window before its context and one Dice So Nice look for
the table - went out in 1.2.80; its part 2 is this version: what an action's window shows is the number the GM judges, every
action that needs a GM ends in one card, in a Class Trial Analyze offers only what identifies Truth Bullets and the GMs refuse a
stash hunt there whoever asks, Tamper shows the trace's number, a failed concealment is told to the room and a weapon a Search
takes from a stash leaves a trace. With it ride the owner's three notes of 26.10 (H83): under Stained Glass the room tile's
picture and the voice tile's portrait lean with their pane, and Create an item in the Item tables window picks its picture from
a grid of the module's own item drawings. None of it has been tried at a real table yet (Known gaps); everything measured below
was measured in the test harness or in Chromium on the glass harness and a stand-in page. CI: Checked.

## Before installing

1. **Back up the world, and note the version you ran,** so a problem can be traced back.
2. **The stashes a student has found are the GMs' to write.** The list a student's sheet keeps of the stashes it has found
   (the flag `drpgStashesFound`) is now held by the GMs: a player's own write of it is put back, and the GMs' search, a rifle of
   a stash and a room's rename read the list as the GMs hold it. A world that ran 1.2.85 has marks taken without that list; such a
   mark reads the sheet's list, and the first compare takes it in and puts nothing back, so the finds made before the update
   stay. The sheet marks store (`sheetMarks`) records, for each mark, which flags it was taken with (`flagsMarked`). No migration
   runs.
3. **Two requests to the GM answer once carried out.** A player's stash hunt (`vault.findStash`) and a reach into a stash
   (`vault.steal`) now wait for the GMs' result: a hunt the GMs refuse gives its price back, and a Search's trace out of a stash
   is left only when the thing moved. No new bridge action and no new socket.
4. **Settings, keys and texts.** No new setting and no new keybinding. `lang/en.json` goes from 3888 strings to 3900 (13 added,
   1 removed, 0 reworded) and `lang/pl.json` from 4693 to 4705 (13 added, 1 removed, 0 reworded); the one removed is
   `DRPG.Action.tierFound` ("Tier {tier}"), which nothing reads any more.

## At the table

### For the GM

- **Sabotage's window shows the bar the GM's band judges.** One function, `sabotageBar`, gives both. With the Despair
  concealment's -1 the window read "beat 11 / 17" while 13 / 19 was needed; it now reads the numbers the judge uses.
- **Dynamic says "beat N".** The difficulty window and the roll window name the band's lower number as "beat {n}", the number
  the roll passes from; the range is gone. A Dynamic action asks the GMs with one card, the one that sets its difficulty, and
  none is left "Awaiting a ruling."; a GM's own Dynamic action posts none.
- **A Dynamic success hands the GM a card**: "The roll succeeded at Tier {tier}. Decide what it gives: an item, or something
  said.", with Create an item (the tables prefilled with the band's tier, the room and the player's words; it gives nothing by
  itself), Give an existing item and Reply. A Reroll that turns a miss into a success posts the card; a Reroll that turns a
  success into a miss ends a card not yet answered with "A Reroll turned this roll into a miss: the success no longer stands,
  and it gives nothing."
- **"Nothing was there." is paid.** On the card of a Search for something specific, "Nothing was there." keeps the action
  spent, and "Refuse the attempt" gives it back. On a hint card, "No help." keeps the action spent beside Reply and "Refuse the
  attempt".
- **In a Class Trial the GMs refuse a stash hunt whoever asks** - the picker, a player's request, a GM's own search and a Reroll
  of a hunt thrown before the trial - before its throw is read, so nothing is found: the picker's choice is refused before any
  price, and for the others the price, or the Reroll, is given back (the owner's rule from E14, "a refusal before the rolls are
  read refunds", applied by analogy). The refusal reads "The Class Trial is in session. Nobody leaves the courtroom until it
  ends."
- **A trap's victim throws Body first** on Leave a clue and Secure a trace (Body / Hand / Leg): where nobody picks - an armed
  Resolve, or the first statistic the GMs' window offers - the victim throws Body.
- **A failed concealment of an indirect murder's work is told to the room on its own** (the owner's Q5), see For everybody.
- **A Palm or a Plant the module could not send to a GM** (the last GM gone between the dice and the ask) gives the action back;
  one sent but not answered stays paid.
- **Create an item (Item tables) picks its picture from a grid** (H83): under Name, a "Picture" row folds out a grid of
  cells - "Category's own" first, which stores nothing so the item takes the category's drawing as before, then one cell for
  each of the module's six item drawings, then "Another file..." last, which opens the file browser as before and shows the
  file picked. The thumbnail is no longer a button; it shows the category's drawing while nothing is chosen. No new image
  files.

### For players

- **Tamper's window shows the chosen trace's number** (the owner's Q7).
- **The Reroll and Resolve windows say what they act on.** A Reroll names the roll it takes back, as "Your {action} roll: {total}
  {duality}."; Resolve says "Your next roll will ask you which statistic to use."
- **A Dynamic success** reads "Success - the GM decides what a Tier {tier} result gives you."
- **In a Class Trial Analyze only identifies Truth Bullets**: no hint, stash or passage row is offered there, and a request for
  one is refused before any price; outside a trial every row is offered and none is greyed. A character with no Truth Bullet
  left to analyse in a trial reads "Nothing here can be done right now."
- **A weapon a Search takes out of a stash leaves a Prep Remnant** (the owner's Q6), by the item's category and roles, as a find
  from a room's table does; a thing that is no weapon leaves none.
- **A Loaded Die counts only where the die held**: where another dice method threw it and it did not come up 12, it gives no
  Free Critical and no card saying "{name} takes the action with one die already set to 12 and throws the other."
- **Projects is not struck through outside a room**, while Search still is. **Rest**, when neither rest can be taken, is dimmed
  with both reasons in its tooltip, and its window shows both rows greyed with their reasons and one "Close" button, where it
  only said "Nothing here can be done right now."
- **"Which statistic?"** stands over its field, the field the row's width, as "Which project?" does (Tamper and a generic action;
  not measured, LIVE-E16-05).
- **An old Observe card** (written before 1.2.50) no longer shows a player the GMs' sentence "Total {total}. Score it against
  the Observe table for whatever they are looking at. A failure costs them {n} Sanity."; a GM reads the card whole.

### For everybody

- **A failed concealment** of an indirect murder's work is told to the students in the room, on its own, as "{actor} is busy
  with something in {room}, and everyone here can see roughly what." - no project named (the owner's Q5); with nobody there,
  nothing is told.
- **Under Stained Glass the room tile's picture and the voice tile's portrait lean with their pane** (H83), by the same angle as
  their tile, as a character's portrait in a block already did. Measured in Chromium: at 1920x1080 the room picture -8 degrees
  and the portrait 8, at 1366x768 6 and 8, each still cut to its pane. Under Monokuma Legacy and in the stacked layout (393x852)
  there is no pane and the pictures stay as they were.

## Known gaps

- **LIVE-E16-05** (item 304, not tried yet): on a v14 table in both themes at 1366x768, in English and Polish, "Which
  statistic?" over a field the row's width in Tamper's and a generic action's window, and the Rest tile dimmed with both
  reasons, its window's two greyed rows and one Close (jsdom lays nothing out).
- **LIVE-E16-06** (item 305, not tried yet): on v14 with Daggerheart 2.10.5, a Loaded Die under another dice method - no Free
  Critical and no card when the die did not show 12, and whether Daggerheart's roll keeps its config where `loadedDieHeld` reads
  it (without it either die at 12 counts); and an Observe card from before 1.2.50 in a real old world.
- **H83's pictures at a real table** are the owner's look, with no LIVE id: a real room picture and portrait on v14 were not
  seen (the harness paints gradients), and on a photo the lean also moves the cover's crop and the portrait's focus. The notice
  frame stays upright (not in the owner's note).
- **Create an item's picture**: `game.drpg.pinItemIcons({ apply: true })` still resets a module drawing that is not the item's
  category's own, so a drawing chosen in the grid does not survive it. Another file's folder glyph and v14's real file browser
  were not seen (the test stands in for the browser); the tab is 20-34 px taller closed and 126-237 px taller open than at
  1.2.85, and under Stained Glass at 1366x768, where it was already taller than the window, it scrolls further; an arrow key
  landing on Another file opens the file browser (Chromium).
- The Reroll window names the roll this browser holds in memory: after a reload it names none.
- A Dynamic success card a GM answered before a Reroll turned the roll into a miss is left as it was, and an item given on it is
  the GMs' to take back. On a Reroll the card's room and words come from the roll's record, as a prefill only.
- A Loaded Die that did not hold still spends its Call. The old-card filter matches the GMs' sentence in the reader's language
  only; an old card written in another language keeps it.
- The trial refusal says "The Class Trial is in session. Nobody leaves the courtroom until it ends.", words written for a move,
  for a stash hunt and a hint as for a passage. A stash hunt's card ("You go over the room looking for anything that does not
  belong.") is posted before the request, so a refused hunt shows the card and then the refusal. A Find Passage refused after
  its throw (a trial opened while the request was on its way) gives no price back.
- Hands too full to take a stash's weapon leave no trace (left for the owner to decide).
- A found list a player wrote before the update, while no mark held it, is taken in at the first compare (it stood at 1.2.85
  anyway); a judgement of the flag on such a mark before any compare would still put it back.
- Not driven by a test: the Tamper window's number on a real player's browser (driven on the GM), a card pressed twice on
  "Nothing was there.", a player's own browser giving a stash hunt's price back (read in the source), a player's Analyze with a
  trial opened while its request is on its way, a Palm's or a Plant's refund on a player's client (the census is read in the
  source), and the leaning layers' readers in R508 and R543, which run only with layout.
- Known leaks whose stages have not shipped are unchanged (8 known leaks, as at 1.2.85).
